definitions.explanation: A brief gathering held at the start of the day in schools, workplaces, or organizations. In schools, students typically line up in the schoolyard for announcements. In companies, it is a short meeting to share information and set the day's agenda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{朝礼|ちょうれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a morning assembly every day.

examples.japanese: {朝礼|ちょうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The principal gave a talk at the morning assembly.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝礼|ちょうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: At our company, we start work after confirming the day's schedule at the morning meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
{朝礼|ちょうれい} is a common practice in both Japanese schools and companies. School {朝礼|ちょうれい} typically involves the whole school gathering in the schoolyard or gym, while workplace {朝礼|ちょうれい} may be a brief stand-up meeting within a department.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝礼|ちょうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak at the morning assembly)
- {朝礼|ちょうれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to attend the morning assembly)
- ⟦{全校|ぜんこう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧{朝礼|ちょうれい} (whole-school morning assembly)
- {朝礼|ちょうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (morning assembly time)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{終礼|しゅうれい}→終礼：23186_shuurei⟧ is the end-of-day meeting or assembly, the counterpart to {朝礼|ちょうれい}.
